prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 horizontal bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 19% of the way down her figure from the top, about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 71% of the way down her figure from the top and about 89% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries thick impasto oil paint in cadmium yellow and viridian, heavy palette-knife ridges catching the light. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied 24K gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and a bright metallic sheen. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries black-and-white op-art checkerboard distorted into a bulging optical illusion. Region 4 is the band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries high-gloss enamel paint in ruby red and cobalt blue, a mirror-glossy coat with wet-looking highlights. Region 5 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living blue-black skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform stiletto heels of real glossy patent leather, each in a main colour of whichever painting that leg falls in, and extra long nails each polished in a main colour of whichever painting that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every brush stroke and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — every inch from neck to ankle filled with painting. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
